name: Product Warranty and Guarantee for WooCommerce
author: MD.Muslim

sections.description:
Product Warranty and Guarantee for WooCommerce lets WooCommerce store owners add professional warranty or guarantee info to their products. It is simple, lightweight, and provides clear warranty details to customers, improving trust and reducing support queries.

Key Features:

  1. Warranty/Guarantee Expiry Date – Add expiry date to each warranty or guarantee. Expired warranties are automatically hidden on the frontend.
  2. Multiple Warranty Options per Product – Add multiple warranty or guarantee options for a single product.
  3. Frontend Tooltip/Popup – Display extra info when hovering over the warranty or guarantee.
  4. Product Badge Type – Choose whether the badge shows “Warranty Available” or “Guarantee Available”.
  5. Custom Badge Text – Admin can customize badge text to match branding.
  6. Badge Position – Choose where the badge appears on the product page (Product Title, Price, or Product Meta Section).

Why use this plugin?

  • Build customer trust: Display clear and accurate warranty/guarantee info.
  • Professional appearance: Badges, tooltips, and expiry dates make your product pages look polished.
  • Upsell opportunities: Multiple warranty options allow flexible offers for your customers.
  • Easy admin control: Badge type, text, and position are fully manageable from the WordPress admin panel.
  • Reduce support queries: Tooltip information and automatic expiry hiding inform customers clearly.

Support

For support, please visit https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/wcpw-product-warranty/ or contact us at support@muslim11.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Products → Edit Product to add warranties or guarantees.
  4. Use the plugin settings page to configure badge type, text, and position.
sections.faq:
Can I add multiple warranties for a single product?

Yes, you can add as many warranty or guarantee options as needed per product.

Can I customize the badge text?

Yes, you can change the text via the plugin settings page.

Will expired warranties be shown on the frontend?

No, expired warranties are automatically hidden from the product page.

Can I control where the badge appears on the product page?

Yes, you can choose the position: Product Title, Price, or Product Meta Section.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes, it is fully compatible with WooCommerce.
